description: Defines classes and functions for high-resolution time management in QUIC, including QuicTime, QuicTimeDelta, and QuicWallTime, with support for durations, timestamps, and comparisons.

classes.name: QuicTimeDelta
classes.description: Represents a duration of time in microseconds, with methods for conversion and comparison.

classes.name: QuicTime
classes.description: Represents a high-precision timestamp with methods for manipulation and comparison.

classes.name: QuicWallTime
classes.description: Represents a UNIX timestamp with methods for conversion and comparison.

methods.name: Zero
methods.description: Returns a QuicTimeDelta with zero duration.

methods.name: Infinite
methods.description: Returns a QuicTimeDelta representing an infinite duration.

methods.name: FromSeconds
methods.description: Creates a QuicTimeDelta from seconds.

methods.name: FromMilliseconds
methods.description: Creates a QuicTimeDelta from milliseconds.

methods.name: FromMicroseconds
methods.description: Creates a QuicTimeDelta from microseconds.

methods.name: ToSeconds
methods.description: Converts QuicTimeDelta to seconds.

methods.name: ToMilliseconds
methods.description: Converts QuicTimeDelta to milliseconds.

methods.name: ToMicroseconds
methods.description: Converts QuicTimeDelta to microseconds.

methods.name: ToAbsl
methods.description: Converts QuicTimeDelta to an absl::Duration.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if the duration is zero.

methods.name: IsInfinite
methods.description: Checks if the duration is infinite.

methods.name: ToDebuggingValue
methods.description: Returns a string representation for debugging.

methods.name: Zero
methods.description: Returns a QuicTime with internal value 0.

methods.name: Infinite
methods.description: Returns a QuicTime with infinite value.

methods.name: ToDebuggingValue
methods.description: Returns internal value for debugging.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if QuicTime is initialized.

methods.name: FromUNIXSeconds
methods.description: Creates a QuicWallTime from UNIX seconds.

methods.name: FromUNIXMicroseconds
methods.description: Creates a QuicWallTime from UNIX microseconds.

methods.name: Zero
methods.description: Returns a QuicWallTime set to zero.

methods.name: ToUNIXSeconds
methods.description: Returns seconds since UNIX epoch.

methods.name: ToUNIXMicroseconds
methods.description: Returns microseconds since UNIX epoch.

methods.name: IsAfter
methods.description: Checks if this time is after another.

methods.name: IsBefore
methods.description: Checks if this time is before another.

methods.name: AbsoluteDifference
methods.description: Returns absolute time difference between two QuicWallTime instances.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a QuicTimeDelta to QuicWallTime.

methods.name: Subtract
methods.description: Subtracts a QuicTimeDelta from QuicWallTime.
